fields.statement: The ArgentSea solution's project membership comprises exactly six product projects — ArgentSea.Shared (built as ArgentSea.csproj), ArgentSea.Sql, ArgentSea.Pg, ArgentSea.Orleans, ArgentSea.Orleans.Sql and ArgentSea.Orleans.Pg — plus exactly one dedicated test project for each of them (ArgentSea.Test, ArgentSea.Sql.Test, ArgentSea.Pg.Test, ArgentSea.Orleans.Test, ArgentSea.Orleans.Sql.Test and ArgentSea.Orleans.Pg.Test), and the shared ArgentSea.TestKit and ArgentSea.Integration.Test projects.
fields.scope: Project composition declared in the ArgentSea.slnx solution file.
